subject.title: Feature request: first-class .env / environment-backed secret config UX

question: What SecretRef source metadata may Control UI expose for env-backed secrets, and should env variable names or resolved/unresolved state be shown by default?
rationale: The requested UX improves secret hygiene but can disclose operator environment names, provider aliases, and setup state, so automation should not choose that boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Conservative Source-Aware UI
options.body: Show masked source labels and resolved/unresolved state, reveal env variable names only where maintainers approve, and keep writes aligned with existing SecretRef configure/apply paths.

options.title: Minimal Read-Only Badge
options.body: Replace generic structured placeholders with a safe `SecretRef configured` badge and leave editing in Raw/CLI until a broader design is approved.

options.title: Defer UI Disclosure
options.body: Keep current UI behavior and improve docs or CLI guidance only until security review defines the metadata policy.

recommendation.title: Conservative Source-Aware UI
recommendation.body: Show masked source labels and resolved/unresolved state, reveal env variable names only where maintainers approve, and keep writes aligned with existing SecretRef configure/apply paths.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the merged SecretRef Control UI/RPC hardening that defines the current safe-but-generic behavior this issue wants to extend.
